subject: Re: CBD kickoff — fixing tail-class accuracy on long-tailed workloads
body:
Reproduction status.

ImageNet-LT: done. Our two-stage runs land within 0.4 of the published CBD overall accuracy, with the expected pattern — big tail-class gains from the class-balanced distillation stage, head classes held by the teacher ensemble. Teacher diversity matters as advertised: dropping the SimCLR-augmented teacher costs 1.9 on tail accuracy.

iNaturalist18: running, ETA next week. No surprises so far.

Internal workload #1 (Linnea): adaptation started. One real trade-off to surface — our internal taxonomy has ~6x more classes than ImageNet-LT, and stage-two class-balanced sampling gets noticeably slower per epoch (input pipeline, not compute). Wanjiru has a sharded sampler prototype that recovers most of it; if it holds, no schedule impact. If not, we may need to trim the go/no-go to one workload by Jun 1.

Tereza
